label: daily-stream-label-shadowed-aligned
description: A Logs Drilldown labels tab breakdown by a stream label that a JSON line's key shadows in VictoriaLogs (semantics/stream-label-shadowed-by-ingest-json-key): api-gateway's stream label version="v2" under JSON lines with a version key of v1 or v2. SL1 is the labels tab with a level pill, SL2 without, SL3 a breakdown by a stream label no key shadows (cluster), SL4 a Drilldown field breakdown by structured metadata the stream does not hold (span_id): the restore runs for both and must keep their values and cost. Run with the control set.
